dialogue_texts: So, this is how the morning looks. After what has happened overnight, I expect things to be broken.
I pulled an all-nighter trying to solve this. I have now run out of time, and I have a massive headache to deal with.
You fought hard, Reimu. The glohm has adapted faster than you anticipated. It is now being pushed into you without a clear plan.
My goal was to put a stop to you and the Order, and now I've failed because things got too strange. It's embarrassing.
Our rules don't just apply here. Look at your hands - the glohm from my residue is now overtaking your body.
Ugh... my fragile little mind is being warped... I'm feeling heavy!
What's your next move? The glohm won't just linger beyond the surface of your skin.
Too bad! Bad ending! To see the good ending, clear the game without using a continue or letting nine hours pass.
